row.proto: uint32_t Vm_Set_NamedValue_ByNameHash(void *self, const char *name, void *value, void *allocator)
row.notes: Lazily allocates a 0x60-byte hash map at self+0x10, optionally remaps name through the alias pool at map+0x50, hashes name with djb2 (seed 0x1505, x33) and looks it up. If present and value type ids match it assigns (vt+0x10) and returns 0; if absent it clones a value of the same type (type vt+8 with map allocator), assigns and inserts {hash,value}. Returns errno 0x16 for null args, 0xc on alloc failure, 0x58 on type mismatch or insert failure. Context from caller: signal/event parameter bag.
